an8.6:1.1: bhikkhave lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti, loko ca aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati.
an8.6:1.3: Lābho ca alābho ca yaso ca ayaso ca nindā ca pasaṃsā ca sukhañ ca dukkhañ ca.
an8.6:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti, loko ca ime aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati. 3.
an8.6:2.1: Assutavato bhikkhave puthujjanassa uppajjati lābho pi alābho pi yaso pi ayaso pi nindā pi pasaṃsā pi sukhaṃ pi dukkhaṃ pi.
an8.6:2.2: Sutavato pi bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābho pi alābho pi yaso pi ayaso pi nindā pi pasaṃsā pi sukhaṃ pi dukkhaṃ pi.
an8.6:2.3: Tatra bhikkhave ko viseso, ko adhippāyoso, kin nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenā ti?
an8.6:2.4: ‘Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavaṃnettikā Bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā; sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī' ti.
an8.6:3.1: Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an8.6:3.2: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.6:3.7: so ca kho anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo' ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti . . .
an8.6:3.17: tañ ca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhamman' ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an8.6:4.1: Tassa lābho pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, alābho pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, yaso pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ayaso pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, nindā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, pasaṃsā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, sukhaṃ pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, dukkhaṃ pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an8.6:4.2: So uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anurujjhati, alābhe paṭivirujjhati,
an8.6:4.6: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhasamāpanno na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi,
an8.6:5.1: Sutavato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābho.
an8.6:5.4: so ca kho anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . .
an8.6:5.14: tañ ca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhamman' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an8.6:6.1: Tassa lābho pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, alābho pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, yaso pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ayaso pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, nindā pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, pasaṃsā pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, sukhaṃ pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, dukkhaṃ pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an8.6:6.2: So uppannaṃ lābhaṃ nānurujjhati, alābhe na ppaṭivirujjhati,
an8.6:6.3: uppannaṃ yasaṃ nānurujjhati, ayase na ppaṭivirujjhati,
an8.6:6.4: uppannaṃ pasaṃsaṃ nānurujjhati, nindāya na ppaṭivirujjhati,
an8.6:6.5: uppannaṃ sukhaṃ nānurujjhati, dukkhe na ppaṭivirujjhati.
an8.6:6.6: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi,
an8.6:6.8: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso, ayaṃ adhippāyoso, idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenā ti.
an8.6:7.1: Lābho alābho ca yaso ayaso ca
